d: Celebrating NDA’s 75 years of unwavering legacy and valour. This documentary serves as a heartfelt tribute to the timeless dedication exemplified by the National Defence Academy. Join us in paying homage to the heroes who, for 75 illustrious years, have sculpted and defined the enduring legacy of this esteemed institution. Experience a captivating journey narrated by the legendary Shri Amitabh Bachchan as we uncover the rich history of the National Defence Academy (NDA) and the unwavering spirit of its cadets.
